Record Class GateContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
frc.spectrumLib.localization.GateContext
Record Components:
nowSeconds - current time, Timer.getTimestamp() base
fusedPose - the fused robot pose before this loop's measurements
odometryPose - the wheel-and-gyro-only pose, never corrected by vision
robotVelocity - robot-relative chassis velocity
peakYawRateRadPerSec - largest |yaw rate| over the configured lookback window
disabled - whether the robot is disabled
headingSeeded - whether a camera has set the field heading yet
robotTiltDegrees - the robot's tilt from level (Pigeon pitch and roll), degrees
public record GateContext(double nowSeconds, Pose2d fusedPose, Pose2d odometryPose, ChassisVelocities robotVelocity, double peakYawRateRadPerSec, boolean disabled, boolean headingSeeded, double robotTiltDegrees) extends Record
Robot state a gate may consult, built once per loop from logged inputs so gating replays deterministically.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
